highlights.headline: Mid-length engagement efficiency +22% YoY while Short-form moved −20%
highlights.detail: Median EER for 3–20 min videos went from 4.43% to 5.41%; Shorts went from 4.33% to 3.44% even as their share of uploads rose from 37% to 47%.

highlights.headline: Critical comments in Opinion & Ethics rose +48% (+13.2 pp)
highlights.detail: 27.4% of scored comments were critical in the prior period vs 40.6% now, across 1,509 comments this year. Positive share moved from 34.5% to 32.5%.

highlights.headline: Uploads +54% YoY, while overall engagement efficiency stayed flat (−2%)
highlights.detail: 1,420 videos this year vs 920 in the same window last year. The flat topline hides opposing moves: Short-form EER moved −20% and Shorts now make up 47% of uploads (was 37%), cancelling the +22% gain in mid-length content.
highlights.evidence: Overall EER 95% CI [−6%, +1%] · p = 0.092 · videos ≥120 days old: −5% (n = 734)

recommendations.title: Anchor production on 8–12m explainers
recommendations.body: The 8–12m band has the highest median EER this year (5.67%, n = 211). Use Shorts as a discovery funnel into those videos rather than as the primary engagement vehicle.

recommendations.title: Ride the Agents & Automation wave — but differentiate
recommendations.body: Agents & Automation grew from 11% to 27% of uploads. Its median within-period Relative Velocity Index is 1.55× (1.00× = typical video of the same age), so demand is still keeping pace with supply. Rising title terms: “workflow”, “agents”, “automate”.

recommendations.title: Apply brand-safety review to Opinion & Ethics placements
recommendations.body: Critical-comment share in Opinion & Ethics is 41% (was 27%). Polarized comment sections raise comment volume but weaken the like signal; pair sponsorships there with comment-moderation commitments, or shift budget to lower-friction subtopics.

recommendations.title: Buy on efficiency, not on reach
recommendations.body: Shorts rose to 47% of supply while their median EER moved −20%. Negotiate integrations on engagement-efficiency benchmarks per format, and treat raw view counts from videos of different ages as non-comparable.

recommendations.title: Reallocate away from News & Releases
recommendations.body: News & Releases fell from 20% to 12% of uploads (p < 0.001). Fewer creators and a shorter shelf life make it a weaker vehicle for evergreen sponsorships.
